messages:
maria: Heads up: proposing an RBAC tighten for the on-prem keystore in the private deployment. Objective: remove cluster-scoped bindings and enforce namespace-isolated roles + explicit audit-writes.

sam: 👍 What's the exact role split? names and verbs please.

maria: Plan: Role `keystore-reader` in `keystore` ns w/ `get,list,watch` on `secrets` and `pods`; Role `keystore-rotator` with `update` on `secrets/keystore-certs` only; RoleBinding from serviceaccount `keystore-agent`. No ClusterRole, no wide verbs.

oliver: How do we ensure audit trails for secret writes and KMS calls? Compliance needs both k8s audit and HSM audit correlated.

maria: We'll keep the audit-webhook endpoint enabled in the priv cluster and add a persistent field `actor.serviceAccount` in the webhook transformation to surface SA email. KMS calls are logged by the HSM — we already send KMS request IDs to our central collector. We'll cross-link by request_id tag.

lyn: Network policy question: the keystore agent needs to talk to customer HSM (PKCS#11) over a single port. Do we permit egress only to HSM IPs or allow control-plane proxy? I'd prefer egress deny-by-default with allowlist.

maria: Egress will be tight: `egress` rule from `keystore` ns to the configured HSM CIDRs on port 1696 (example), plus DNS and time sync. No control-plane egress. We'll document CIDRs in the runbook.

sec-bot: [automated] Suggest running `kubectl auth reconcile --manifest=keystore-roles.yaml --dry-run=server` before apply.

sam: Vulnerability note: scanner flagged old glibc in the keystore image. We have a patched image `keystore:v2.1.3`. Do not rollout both RBAC and image in same change — separation of concerns.

maria: Agreed — RBAC + NetPol + audit changes first. Image patch after validation. We'll keep canary at 5% for 1 hour and monitor error budget.

oliver: For rollback/incident steps: if agent fails to read secret -> 1) alert `keystore_agent_errors_total{reason="auth"}` fires, 2) run `kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:keystore:agent get secrets/keystore-certs`, 3) capture apiserver audit for that SA: `kubectl get auditlogs --selector=sa=keystore-agent` (or pull from webhook store), 4) if misconfig revert previous RoleBinding.

lyn: Add a quick check script to the runbook:

```bash
# smoke check
kubectl --namespace=keystore run --rm -i --restart=Never check --image=busybox -- sh -c 'kubectl auth can-i get secrets/keystore-certs --as=system:serviceaccount:keystore:agent && curl -sS https://hsm.example/ping'
```

sam: Also require an ephemeral breakglass flow for SRE: OIDC short-lived token that can be issued via the internal portal for 30m, and audit the session with ttyrec. No static keys.

maria: Noted. I'll add an approval step for those tokens scoped to `keystore` namespace only.

oliver: NetPol draft (deny all ingress, explicit egress allowlist):

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: keystore-default-deny
  namespace: keystore
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress
  ingress: []
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.254.10.0/28   # HSM range
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 1696
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-app: monitoring
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 9090
```

maria: Looks good. We'll need hostNetwork exemptions for CNI health-checks — will add annotation per CNI vendor.

lyn: Triage note: when you tighten RBAC, kube-proxy or sidecars that previously had broader access may break. Add a preflight script that runs `kubectl auth can-i` across known automation SAs.

maria: Will include a preflight checklist: auth checks, netpol connectivity tests, audit webhook lint, and smoke rotate test.

sec-bot: [automated] Runbook stub created: https://confluence.internal/redwood/priv-keystore-hardening — includes rollback commands, smoke commands, and contact rotation matrix.

sam: One more compliance ask: add a hashed correlation id in each k8s audit entry and as a header on KMS requests so forensic correlation doesn't rely on plaintext SA names.

maria: We'll inject `x-rw-request-id` with SHA256(request_id + namespace) and store mapping in audit index.

oliver: Schedule: staging rollout tomorrow 08:30 UTC canary 5% 1h, then promote if green. Post-rollout checklist: verify audit pairing for at least 10 rotations.

maria: I'll open the PR with Role manifests, RoleBindings, NetPol, audit webhook patch, and the runbook. Tagging @sam @oliver @lyn for review. :lock:
